input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, user management domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include user, base impl, i base. Core business data revolves around UserLoginValidGroup, UserRole.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a User, I want to interact with base impl functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a User, I want to interact with i base functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a User, I want to interact with i user functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a User, I want to interact with user realm functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
